source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 16 (PDF 336-349), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Lab Safety and Practical Skills (running header: Identifying Hazards and Designing Safe Experiments)) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 According to the chapter, a chemistry laboratory is described as:
(Chapter ke mutabiq chemistry laboratory ko kya kaha gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.1: Chemistry laboratory chemist ki workshop hai jahan student ko substances ki physical aur chemical khasusiyat dekhna sikhaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A chemistry laboratory is a chemist workshop

blocks.prompt:
2 In the laboratory a student is trained to observe the characteristics of substances by:
(Laboratory mein student substances ki khasusiyat kis tarah dekhna seekhta hai?)

options.text: muqarrar tareeqay (definite procedures) par chal kar
akele baghair rehnumai ke kaam kar ke

blocks.explanation: 16.1: Student muqarrar tareeqay (definite procedures) par chal kar khasusiyat dekhta hai.

book_ref.quote: trained to observe the physical and chemical characteristics of substances by following definite procedures

blocks.prompt:
3 While working in the lab, a student should always wear:
(Lab mein kaam karte waqt student ko hamesha kya pehnna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 16.1: Hamesha lab coat aur safety goggles (hifazati ainak) pehnein; larkiyan scarf aur baal baandh lein.

book_ref.quote: Students should always wear lab coat and safety goggles while working in the lab

blocks.prompt:
4 Experiments in the lab should be performed:
(Lab mein experiments kis tarah karne chahiye?)

options.text: lab instructor aur staff ki mojoodgi mein

blocks.explanation: 16.1: Akele kaam na karein; experiments lab instructor aur staff ki mojoodgi mein karein.

book_ref.quote: Experiments should be performed in the presence of lab instructor and other laboratory staff

blocks.prompt:
5 If a piece of glassware breaks during work, the student should:
(Agar kaam ke dauran glassware toot jaye to student ko kya karna chahiye?)

options.text: kaam jaari rakhna aur agle hafte batana

blocks.explanation: 16.1: Har hadsa ya glassware tootna foran lab incharge ko batayein.

book_ref.quote: Any accident or breakage of glassware must be reported to the incharge of the laboratory immediately

blocks.prompt:
6 Which practice is NOT allowed in the laboratory?
(Laboratory mein kaun sa kaam mana hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.1: Chemicals drain mein na daalein aur sewer ko chemical waste ke liye istemal na karein.

book_ref.quote: Do not pour chemicals down the drains and do not utilize the sewer for chemical waste disposal

blocks.prompt:
7 The potential hazards of an equipment or experiment should be determined:
(Kisi equipment ya experiment ke mumkina khatraat (potential hazards) kab maloom karne chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 16.1: Kaam shuru karne se pehle khatraat maloom karein aur hifazati ehtiyaat karein.

book_ref.quote: Determine the potential hazards related to any equipment or the experiment before beginning any work

blocks.text: 16.2 Common types of hazards in a laboratory

blocks.prompt:
8 Most laboratory hazards fall into how many categories?
(Lab ke zyada tar khatraat kitni qismon mein aate hain?)

options.text: chaar: physical, chemical, biological aur electrical

blocks.explanation: 16.2: Zyada tar khatraat teen qismon mein hain: physical, chemical aur biological.

book_ref.quote: fall into three categories, physical, chemical and biological hazards

blocks.prompt:
9 The most common physical hazards in a laboratory are:
(Lab mein sab se aam physical hazards kaun se hain?)

options.text: geelay farsh par phisalna aur girna

blocks.explanation: 16.2.1: Sab se aam physical hazards geelay farsh par phisalna aur girna hain.

book_ref.quote: The most common physical hazards are slips and falls when working on wet floor

blocks.prompt:
10 While handling broken glassware, a worker should wear:
(Tootay hue glassware ko uthate waqt worker ko kya pehnna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 16.2.1: Cut-resistant gloves (katne se bachane wale dastane) zakhm aur jild ke nuqsan se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: A worker should wear cut-resistant gloves while handling the broken glassware

blocks.prompt:
11 Broken glassware should be disposed of:
(Toota hua glassware kahan phainkna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 16.2.1: Toota glassware khaas container mein daalein taa ke kisi ko chot na lage.

book_ref.quote: dispose off broken glassware in special container to prevent injury

blocks.prompt:
12 To avoid chemical hazards, a laboratory worker must use the chemicals:
(Chemical hazards se bachne ke liye chemicals kis tarah istemal karne chahiye?)

options.text: standard tareeqay ke mutabiq, khaas khatraat ko samne rakh kar
jab koi na dekh raha ho

blocks.explanation: 16.2.2: Chemicals standard tareeqay ke mutabiq, un ke khaas khatraat aur ehtiyaat ko samne rakh kar istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: use the chemicals according to the standard procedures keeping in view the particular hazards

blocks.prompt:
13 Which of these is a biological hazard?
(In mein se kaun sa biological hazard hai?)

options.text: janwaron se insanon mein aane wali infectious bimari

blocks.explanation: 16.2.3: Aam biological hazards: allergens, janwaron se insanon mein aane wali mutaddi (infectious) bimariyan aur viral bimariyan.

book_ref.quote: infectious diseases which are transferred from animals to humans and viral diseases

blocks.prompt:
14 Slipping, pulling and falling are examples of:
(Phisalna, khinchna aur girna kis qism ke hazards ki misalein hain?)
blocks.explanation: 16.2.1: Phisalna, khinchna aur girna physical hazards se mutaliq hadsay hain.

book_ref.quote: A worker must take all types of precautions to avoid accidents related to physical hazards

blocks.prompt:
15 Chemical waste should be disposed of according to the rules of:
(Chemical waste kis idaare ke qawaid ke mutabiq phainkna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 16.3: Chemical waste bins ya sewer mein nahi jata; Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) ke qawaid ke mutabiq phainka jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Chemical waste cannot be disposed of in bins or sewer system

blocks.prompt:
16 A chemical waste container should be labelled with:
(Chemical waste ke container par kya likha jana chahiye?)

options.text: waste ki qism, tareekh aur place of origin

blocks.explanation: 16.3: Container par waste ki qism, tareekh aur kahan se aaya (place of origin) likha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Label the chemical waste containers with the types of wastes, the date of waste and place of origin

blocks.prompt:
17 Which of the following is NOT listed as a chemical treatment of wastes?
(In mein se kaun sa waste ka chemical treatment nahi bataya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: 16.3: Chemical treatment: neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction; sewer istemal nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: Chemical treatment of wastes involves neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation or reduction

blocks.prompt:
18 After storing and labelling, chemical waste containers are:
(Store aur label karne ke baad chemical waste ke containers ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: lab table par rakhe rehte hain
muqarrar jagah bheje jate hain jahan treatment hota hai

blocks.explanation: 16.3: Containers muqarrar jagah (allocated site) bheje jate hain jahan un ka munasib treatment hota hai.

book_ref.quote: These containers are then transferred to the allocated site

blocks.prompt:
19 For a minor cut, after removing any glass piece, one should apply:
(Chhote zakhm par, sheeshe ka tukra nikaal kar, kya lagana chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 16.4: Methylated spirit ya tincture iodine cotton se lagayein; dono disinfectant (jaraseem kush) hain.

book_ref.quote: apply a little methylated spirit or tincture iodine with a piece of cotton

blocks.prompt:
20 For a serious cut, pressure is applied on the cut for about:
(Gehre zakhm par khoon rokne ke liye kitni dair dabao dena chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 16.4: Taqreeban 10 minute dabao dein, phir doctor se mashwara karein.

book_ref.quote: Apply pressure on the cut for about 10 minutes to stop bleeding

blocks.prompt:
21 If acid goes into the eye, it is washed with water and then with:
(Aankh mein acid chala jaye to paani ke baad kis se dhoyein?)
blocks.explanation: 16.4: Aankh mein acid: paani se, phir 1% sodium bicarbonate solution (kamzor base) se dhoyein.

book_ref.quote: Wash thoroughly with water and then with 1% sodium bicarbonate solution

blocks.prompt:
22 Alkali in the eye is treated by washing with water followed by:
(Aankh mein alkali chala jaye to paani ke baad kis se dhoyein?)
blocks.explanation: 16.4: Aankh mein alkali: paani, phir 1% boric acid solution (kamzor acid).

book_ref.quote: Wash with water followed by 1% boric acid solution

blocks.prompt:
23 For a foreign particle in the eye, the correct first aid is:
(Aankh mein koi zarra chala jaye to sahih first aid kya hai?)

options.text: aankh na malein; naram rumaal se nikaal kar paani se dhoyein

blocks.explanation: 16.4: Aankh na malein; naram rumaal se zarra nikaal kar paani se dhoyein.

book_ref.quote: Do not rub the eyes. Remove the particle carefully with soft handkerchief then wash with water.

blocks.prompt:
24 Soreness in the eye is relieved by:
(Aankh ki dukhan (soreness) ke liye kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: olive oil ka qatra, aankhein kuch dair band

blocks.explanation: 16.4: Aankh mein olive oil ka aik qatra daal kar kuch dair band rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Put a drop of olive oil in the eyes and keep them closed for some time.

blocks.prompt:
25 An alkali burn is washed with water and then with:
(Alkali se jalne par paani ke baad kis se dhoya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.4 (Book correction): alkali burn ko kamzor acid se neutralise karte hain: paani, phir 1% acetic acid, phir paani, sukha kar burnol.

book_ref.quote: An acid burn is neutralised with a weak base and an alkali burn with a weak acid

blocks.prompt:
26 A bromine burn is treated with:
(Bromine se jalne ka ilaaj kis se hota hai?)

options.text: 2% ammonia solution, phir glycerin aur baad mein burnol

blocks.explanation: 16.4 (Book correction): bromine burn: 2% ammonia solution se dhoyein, glycerin lagayein, phir burnol.

book_ref.quote: bromine burns: wash with 2% ammonia solution and apply glycerin, then burnol

blocks.prompt:
27 A burn caused by dry heat (a flame or hot object) is treated by applying:
(Khushk garmi (shola ya garam cheez) se jalne par kya lagayein?)
blocks.explanation: 16.4: Khushk garmi se jalne par burnol ya mustard oil (sarson ka tel) lagayein.

book_ref.quote: burns with dry heat: apply burnol or mustard oil

blocks.prompt:
28 If an acid is swallowed, the person should drink a lot of water or:
(Agar acid nigal liya jaye to bohat sa paani ya kya piyein?)

options.text: lime water or milk of magnesia

blocks.explanation: 16.4: Acid nigalne par bohat sa paani ya lime water ya milk of magnesia piyein.

book_ref.quote: Drink a lot of water or lime water or milk of magnesia.

blocks.prompt:
29 If a caustic alkali is swallowed, the person should drink a lot of water and then:
(Caustic alkali nigal liya jaye to paani ke baad kya piyein?)

options.text: lemon ya orange juice ka gilaas

blocks.explanation: 16.4: Caustic alkali nigalne par bohat paani aur lemon ya orange juice ka gilaas.

book_ref.quote: Drink a lot of water; drink a glass of lemon or orange juice.

blocks.prompt:
30 When a salt of a heavy metal is swallowed, the first aid is to take:
(Heavy metal ka namak nigal liya jaye to kya diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.4: Heavy metal ka namak nigalne par doodh ya anday ki safedi lein.

book_ref.quote: Take milk or white part of the egg.

blocks.prompt:
31 A beaker of inflammable liquid catches fire. Covering it with a damp cloth puts out the fire because it:
(Jalne wale liquid ke beaker mein aag lag jaye to geela kapra dalne se aag kyun bujhti hai?)

options.text: oxygen ki supply band kar deta hai
beaker ko 0 °C tak thanda kar deta hai
liquid mein paani mila deta hai
liquid ko neutralise kar deta hai

blocks.explanation: 16.4: Duster ya geela kapra oxygen ki supply band kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Cover the beaker with a duster or damp cloth. This will cut off the supply of oxygen.

blocks.prompt:
32 Burning spirit or oil should be put out with:
(Jalti hui spirit ya tel ki aag kis se bujhayein?)

options.text: rait aur sodium bicarbonate ka mixture

blocks.explanation: 16.4: Rait aur sodium bicarbonate ka mixture daalein; paani aag ko phaila deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Throw a mixture of sand and sodium bicarbonate. Do not throw water. It will simply spread the fire.

blocks.prompt:
33 When electric parts catch fire, the first step is to:
(Bijli ke parts mein aag lag jaye to pehla qadam kya hai?)

options.text: supply chalti rakh kar geela kambal daalna
bijli band kar ke rait daalna

blocks.explanation: 16.4: Foran bijli band karein aur rait daalein; paani hargiz nahi.

book_ref.quote: Switch off the electric supply immediately and throw sand.

blocks.prompt:
34 If a person's clothes catch fire, he should:
(Agar kisi ke kapron mein aag lag jaye to use kya karna chahiye?)

options.text: bhaage nahi; kambal mein lipat kar farsh par let jaye

blocks.explanation: 16.4: Bhaagein nahi; kambal ya sookhe cotton kapre mein lipat kar farsh par let jayein.

book_ref.quote: Do not run. Wrap with blanket or with dry cotton cloth. Lie down on the floor.

blocks.prompt:
35 Volumetric analysis finds the concentrations of solutions by a technique called:
(Volumetric analysis kis technique se solutions ki concentration maloom karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Volumetric analysis titration ke zariye concentration maloom karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Volumetric analysis is used to find the concentrations of solutions by means of a technique known as titration

blocks.prompt:
36 A substance that shows the completion of a reaction by a change in its colour is called:
(Jo substance rang badal kar reaction ke mukammal hone ka pata deta hai use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Jo substance rang badal kar reaction ki takmeel batata hai use indicator kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The substance which indicates the completion of reaction by the change in its colour is called an indicator.

blocks.prompt:
37 The moment at which the indicator changes colour is called the:
(Jis lamhe indicator rang badalta hai use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Indicator ke rang badalne ka lamha end point kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: The moment at which the indicator changes colour is called the end point.

blocks.prompt:
38 In an acid-base titration, which solution is taken in the burette?
(Acid-base titration mein burette mein kaun sa solution liya jata hai?)

options.text: koi bhi solution, doosra conical flask mein

blocks.explanation: 16.5: Koi bhi solution burette mein liya ja sakta hai, doosra conical (titration) flask mein.

book_ref.quote: Either solution can be taken in a burette with the other solution taken in a conical or a titration flask.

blocks.prompt:
39 Phenolphthalein solution is made with 1 g of indicator in 500 cm³ of 50% ethanol. How much indicator is needed for 250 cm³ of the same solution?
(Phenolphthalein solution 1 g indicator ko 500 cm³ 50% ethanol mein daal kar banta hai. Isi solution ke 250 cm³ ke liye kitna indicator chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: 1 g har 500 cm³ ke liye, is liye 250 cm³ ke liye 1 × 250/500 = 0.5 g.

book_ref.quote: Phenolphthalein solution is prepared by adding one gram of the indicator in 500 cm³ of 50% ethanol.

blocks.prompt:
40 Phenolphthalein changes colour from pink to colourless when the pH:
(Phenolphthalein ka rang pink se colourless kab hota hai?)

options.text: theek 7 ho kar phir barhta hai

blocks.explanation: 16.5: pH kam hone par rang pink se colourless (berang) hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The color change is from pink to colorless as the pH decreases.

blocks.prompt:
41 The light pink colour at the end point fades gradually because of:
(End point ka halka pink rang aahista aahista kyun halka parta hai?)

options.text: hawa ki carbon dioxide ka aahista solution mein hal hona

blocks.explanation: 16.5: Hawa ki CO₂ aahista solution mein hal hoti hai aur halka pink rang mitta jata hai.

book_ref.quote: tends to fade gradually due to the interference of atmospheric carbon dioxide

blocks.prompt:
42 Which of these is NOT listed among the materials for the HCl-NaOH titration?
(HCl-NaOH titration ke saaman mein kaun si cheez shamil nahi?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Saaman: burette, pipette, funnel, conical flask, HCl, NaOH, phenolphthalein; burner ki zaroorat nahi.

book_ref.quote: Burette, pipette, funnel, conical flask, HCl solution, NaOH solution, phenolphthalein.

blocks.prompt:
43 The products of the reaction between NaOH(aq) and HCl(aq) are:
(NaOH(aq) aur HCl(aq) ke reaction ki products kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: NaOH(aq) + HCl(aq) → NaCl(aq) + H₂O(l).

book_ref.quote: No. of moles of the base in the balanced chemical equation

blocks.prompt:
44 Before the titration, the conical flask is rinsed with:
(Titration se pehle conical flask kis se dhoya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Conical flask sirf distilled water se dhoyein (pipette aur burette paani ke baad apne solution se).

book_ref.quote: Rinse the conical flask with distilled water only.

blocks.prompt:
45 In this titration the pipette is rinsed first with distilled water and then with:
(Is titration mein pipette pehle distilled water aur phir kis se dhoya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Pipette pehle distilled water, phir usi NaOH solution se jo is mein liya jayega.

book_ref.quote: Rinse the pipette first with distilled water and then with the given NaOH solution.

blocks.prompt:
46 Some acid is run from the burette into a beaker before titrating in order to:
(Titration se pehle burette se thora acid beaker mein kyun nikala jata hai?)

options.text: acid ko patla karne ke liye
nozzle mein hawa ka bulbula nikalne ke liye
acid ka rang dekhne ke liye

blocks.explanation: 16.5: Nozzle (nali ki nok) mein mojood hawa ka bulbula nikalne ke liye.

book_ref.quote: allow the acid to flow into a beaker to remove any air bubble present in the nozzle

blocks.prompt:
47 The initial burette reading is noted using:
(Burette ki initial reading kis ki madad se note ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Initial reading anti-parallax card ya safed kaghaz se note karein.

book_ref.quote: Note the burette reading as an initial reading using an anti-parallax card or a white paper.

blocks.prompt:
48 During titration the conical flask is placed on a white paper so that:
(Titration ke dauran conical flask safed kaghaz par kyun rakha jata hai?)

options.text: indicator ka rang badalna saaf nazar aaye

blocks.explanation: 16.5: Safed kaghaz par indicator ke rang ki tabdeeli saaf nazar aati hai.

book_ref.quote: place the conical flask on a white paper under the burette to see the color change

blocks.prompt:
49 NaOH with phenolphthalein is in the flask and HCl is added from the burette. At the end point the solution:
(Flask mein NaOH aur phenolphthalein hai aur burette se HCl daala jata hai. End point par solution ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: colourless se pink ho jata hai
pink se colourless ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: 16.5 (Book correction): flask mein NaOH ho aur acid daalein to end point par pink rang bilkul ghaib ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: pink colour just disappears and the solution becomes colourless

blocks.prompt:
50 When one or two drops of phenolphthalein are added to the NaOH solution in the flask, the solution turns:
(Flask ke NaOH solution mein phenolphthalein ke 1-2 qatre daalne par rang kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: NaOH solution phenolphthalein se pink ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Add one to two drops of phenolphthalein indicator into it. The solution turns pink.

blocks.prompt:
51 The initial burette reading is 1.20 cm³ and the final reading is 11.70 cm³. The volume of acid used is:
(Burette ki initial reading 1.20 cm³ aur final reading 11.70 cm³ hai. Istemal hone wale acid ka volume kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Volume = final − initial = 11.70 − 1.20 = 10.50 cm³.

book_ref.quote: The difference of final and initial readings of burette will give the volume of the acid used.

blocks.prompt:
52 Four titre volumes are 12.40, 12.45, 12.50 and 12.95 cm³. Which reading is NOT concordant with the others?
(Chaar titre volumes 12.40, 12.45, 12.50 aur 12.95 cm³ hain. Kaun si reading baaqi se concordant (milti julti) nahi?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Concordant readings 0.1 cm³ ke andar milti hain; 12.40, 12.45, 12.50 milti hain, 12.95 taqreeban 0.5 cm³ alag hai.

book_ref.quote: Take at least three concordant readings which agree with one another within 0.1 cm³.

blocks.prompt:
53 The first (rough) titration is carried out by adding the acid from the burette:
(Pehli (rough) titration mein burette se acid kis tarah daala jata hai?)

options.text: funnel burette mein laga rehne de kar
qatra qatra, flask ghuma kar milate hue

blocks.explanation: 16.5: Acid qatra qatra daalein aur flask ghuma kar (swirl) achhi tarah milayein.

book_ref.quote: Carry out a rough titration by adding hydrochloric acid solution from the burette drop wise

blocks.prompt:
54 In the molarity equation M₁V₁/n₁ = M₂V₂/n₂, the symbol n₁ stands for:
(Molarity equation M₁V₁/n₁ = M₂V₂/n₂ mein n₁ kya hai?)

options.text: balanced equation mein acid ke moles ki tadaad

blocks.explanation: 16.5: n₁ = balanced chemical equation mein acid ke moles ki tadaad.

book_ref.quote: n₁ = No. of moles of the acid in the balanced chemical equation

blocks.prompt:
55 10 cm³ of NaOH solution needs 15.0 cm³ of 0.20 M HCl for neutralisation (1:1 reaction). The molarity of the NaOH solution is:
(10 cm³ NaOH solution ko neutralise karne ke liye 0.20 M HCl ke 15.0 cm³ lagte hain (1:1 reaction). NaOH ki molarity kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Find out the molarity of NaOH solution by using the following molarity equation:

blocks.prompt:
56 In the observation table, if x is the final reading and y the initial reading, the volume of acid used is:
(Observation table mein x final reading aur y initial reading ho to acid ka volume kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.5: Acid ka volume = (x − y).

book_ref.quote: Volume of acid used (cm³)

blocks.prompt:
57 A solid sample gives brisk effervescence with dilute HCl, and the gas turns lime water milky. The anion is:
(Solid sample dilute HCl ke saath tez jhaag (effervescence) deta hai aur gas lime water ko doodhiya karti hai. Anion kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.6 (a): Carbonate dilute HCl se CO₂ deta hai; CO₂ lime water ko doodhiya (CaCO₃) karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Effervescence takes place during which a gas evolves briskly

blocks.prompt:
58 Lime water turns milky with CO₂ because of the formation of:
(CO₂ se lime water doodhiya kyun hota hai? Kis cheez ke banne se?)
blocks.explanation: 16.6: Ca(OH)₂(aq) + CO₂(g) → CaCO₃(s) (safed ppt) + H₂O(l).

book_ref.quote: Pass the gas evolved in the above step through a solution of lime water

blocks.prompt:
59 An acidified salt solution gives a thick white precipitate with AgNO₃ which dissolves in aqueous NH₃. The ion present is:
(Acidified namak ka solution AgNO₃ se gaarha safed precipitate deta hai jo aqueous NH₃ mein hal ho jata hai. Kaun sa ion hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.6 (b): Gaarha safed precipitate (AgCl) jo NH₃ mein hal ho, Cl¹⁻ batata hai.

book_ref.quote: A thick white precipitate is formed which dissolves in aq.NH₃.

blocks.prompt:
60 With acidified AgNO₃ solution, bromide ions give:
(Acidified AgNO₃ ke saath bromide ions kya dete hain?)

options.text: NH₃ mein hal hone wala safed precipitate

blocks.explanation: 16.6 (b): Br¹⁻ cream-yellow precipitate (AgBr) deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A thick cream-yellow precipitate is formed.

blocks.prompt:
61 A bright yellow precipitate with acidified AgNO₃ solution indicates:
(Acidified AgNO₃ ke saath chamakdar peela precipitate kis ion ka pata deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.6 (b): Iodide AgI ka chamakdar peela precipitate deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A bright yellow precipitate is formed.

blocks.prompt:
62 In the tests for halide ions, dilute HNO₃ is added before AgNO₃ in order to:
(Halide ions ke tests mein AgNO₃ se pehle dilute HNO₃ kyun daala jata hai?)

options.text: precipitate ko rangeen banane ke liye
carbonate ions ko halide ke saath precipitate hone se rokne ke liye
silver halide hal karne ke liye
test ke liye nitrate ions dene ke liye

blocks.explanation: 16.6: Dilute nitric acid carbonate ions ko halide ke saath precipitate hone se rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: dilute nitric acid is added to prevent the precipitation of carbonate ions

blocks.prompt:
63 In the test for nitrate ions, the salt solution is treated with NaOH solution and:
(Nitrate ion ke test mein namak ke solution mein NaOH ke saath kya daala jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.6 (c): NaOH aur aluminium powder daala jata hai; NH₃ gas nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Finally add 3 g of powdered aluminium metal.

blocks.prompt:
64 In the nitrate test, the gas evolved near the mouth of the test tube:
(Nitrate test mein test tube ke munh par nikalne wali gas kya karti hai?)

options.text: NH₃ hai aur laal litmus ko neela karti hai
CO₂ hai aur lime water doodhiya karti hai

(Aluminium se nitrate ki reduction ki balanced equation mein 3 moles NO₃¹⁻ ke saath kitne moles Al react karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 16.6: 3NO₃¹⁻ + 8Al + 5OH⁻ + 18H₂O → 3NH₃ + 8[Al(OH)₄]¹⁻.

book_ref.quote: reduces nitrate ions to ammonium ions which then react with aqueous NaOH

blocks.explanation: 16.6 (d): SO₄²⁻ + Ba²⁺ → BaSO₄(s), bhaari safed precipitate.

69 A salt solution gives a white gelatinous precipitate with NaOH solution and a white precipitate with a few drops of aqueous ammonia. The cation (as described in 16.7 a) is:
(Namak ka solution NaOH se safed gelatinous (jelly jaisa) precipitate aur thore aqueous ammonia se safed precipitate deta hai. Cation (16.7 a) kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.7 (a): Al³⁺ NaOH se Al(OH)₃ ka safed gelatinous precipitate aur ammonia se safed precipitate deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A white gelatinous precipitate is formed.

blocks.prompt:
70 A salt warmed gently with NaOH solution gives a gas with a distinct smell that turns moist red litmus blue. The cation is:
(Namak NaOH ke saath halka garam karne par khaas boo wali gas deta hai jo geele laal litmus ko neela karti hai. Cation kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 16.7 (b): NH₄¹⁺ + OH¹⁻ → NH₃(g) + H₂O(l); ammonia geele laal litmus ko neela karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Add NaOH solution and gently heat it.

options.text: safed precipitate jo zyada NaOH mein hal nahi hota
safed precipitate jo zyada NaOH mein hal ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: 16.7 (c): Ca²⁺ safed Ca(OH)₂ deta hai jo zyada NaOH mein hal nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: White precipitate is formed which does not dissolve in excess of NaOH solution.

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: 16.7 (d): Cr³⁺ hara Cr(OH)₃ deta hai, zyada NaOH mein hara solution, zyada ammonia mein na-hal.
